verdict.rationale: Session data is written to local disk and developers can plug in their own SessionStore backend (object store, KV, DB), giving them practical control over where data lives and thus indirect control over retention/deletion, but there is no documented API, setting, or policy specifically for deleting or setting retention windows for session/transcript data. missing for 10: explicit deletion API, documented retention period controls, and any first-party statement on data lifecycle/compliance.
